entities.summary: Sergey Stepanovich Lanskoy was a Russian politician who served as the minister of the interior from 1855 to 1861, being inaugurated during a reform-minded era and dismissed after the emancipation reform of 1861. He is known for being close friends with Nikolay Milyutin, who drafted the Russian Emancipation proclamation, and with his brother, Dmitry Milyutin, who was serving as the minister of war.
